supplyBaseSummary: Annual supply base report for 2024 covering 8,245.5 m3 of biomass harvested from certified and controlled sources in the Pacific Northwest supply base.
sourcingPractices: Sourcing from FSC-certified forest management units and SBP-evaluated supply base areas; low-risk designation maintained for all sourcing regions.
sustainabilityMeasures: Biodiversity monitoring, soil conservation practices, water quality protection, 98.2 percent sustainable sourcing.
